    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    cars = image_patch.find("white car")
    residential_area = image_patch.find("residential area")
    
    if not cars or not residential_area:
        return []
    
    residential_area_bounds = [
        min([r.left for r in residential_area]),
        min([r.lower for r in residential_area]),
        max([r.right for r in residential_area]),
        max([r.upper for r in residential_area])
    ]
    
    near_cars = [car for car in cars if 
                 car.left < residential_area_bounds[2] and 
                 car.lower < residential_area_bounds[3] and 
                 car.right > residential_area_bounds[0] and 
                 car.upper > residential_area_bounds[1]]
    
    return near_cars
